scripts.type-check: turbo run build openapi:check && bun run db:check && bun run compatibility:check && bun run requirements:check && bun run architecture:check && bun run infra:typecheck
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint eslint.config.js tests && bun run check:boundaries
scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun scripts/run-bun-test-group.mjs unit --coverage --timeout 30000
scripts.test:m9-acceptance: bun run build && bun test tests/m9-production-hardening.test.mjs && bun run security:scan && bun run test:load
scripts.test:m10-conformance: bun run build && bun test tests/m10-portability-conformance.test.mjs && bun run --filter @control-plane/profile-portability test
scripts.test:m10-operability: bun run build && bun test tests/m10-operability.test.mjs && bun run --filter @control-plane/deployment test
scripts.test:m11-standalone: bun run build && bun test tests/m3-durable-execution.test.mjs tests/m4-runtime-fabric.test.mjs tests/m5-runtime-gateway.test.mjs tests/m6-runtime-adapters.test.mjs tests/m7-tools-models-sandboxes.test.mjs tests/m8-multi-agent-orchestration.test.mjs tests/m10-portability-conformance.test.mjs tests/m11-standalone-e2e.test.mjs --timeout 60000 && bun run --filter @control-plane/context test && bun run --filter @control-plane/cortana-context-adapter test && bun run --filter @control-plane/remote-control-relay test && bun run --filter @control-plane/profile-portability test && bun run --filter @control-plane/deployment test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun scripts/run-bun-test-group.mjs e2e --timeout 30000
scripts.test:smoke: bun run build && bun scripts/run-bun-test-group.mjs smoke --timeout 30000
scripts.test:foundation: bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:m4-acceptance: bun --cwd=apps/control-api run build && bun test tests/m4-runtime-fabric.test.mjs
scripts.test:m5-acceptance: bun run build && bun test tests/m5-runtime-gateway.test.mjs
scripts.test:m6-acceptance: bun run build && bun test tests/m6-runtime-adapters.test.mjs
scripts.test:m7-acceptance: bun run build && bun test tests/m7-tools-models-sandboxes.test.mjs
scripts.test:shard: bun run build && bun scripts/run-bun-test-group.mjs unit --timeout 30000
